Meezoeken naar oplossingen bij technische of kwaliteitsgerelateerde uitdagingen. Registreren van productie- en kwaliteitsgegevens. Rapporteren aan de teamleader over prestaties, afwijkingen en verbeterpunten. Waken over veiligheid, hygiëne en orde binnen de productieomgeving. Wat zoeken we? Inzicht in geautomatiseerde productieprocessen en complexe installaties is een must. Je hebt een sterk logisch redeneervermogen en technische feeling. Interesse om verder te groeien binnen een productieomgeving mag niet ontbreken. Zelfstandig werken en verantwoordelijkheid opnemen doe je met plezier. Een goede kennis van het Nederlands is noodzakelijk voor veiligheid en communicatie. Je bent bereid om te werken in een volcontinu 5-ploegensysteem. Wat bieden we? Je krijgt onmiddellijk een contract van onbepaalde duur. Er zijn reële doorgroeimogelijkheden voor sterke profielen op lange termijn. Hier heerst een bedrijfscultuur waarin inzet en engagement gewaardeerd worden. Werken via Synergie Careers Bij Synergie Careers begeleiden we je persoonlijk tijdens het volledige sollicitatieproces. We bekijken samen of jouw ervaring en ambities aansluiten bij de functie en zorgen voor een transparante opvolging van jouw kandidatuur. De volgende stap Ben jij een ervaren operator met technische bagage en zoek je een stabiele uitdaging binnen een moderne productieomgeving waar je verder kan groeien? Solliciteer vandaag nog en ontdek wat deze functie jou te bieden heeft. Wie je ook bent, bij ons krijgt ieder talent de kans om te groeien. Diversiteit en inclusie zijn vanzelfsprekend en samen creëren we impact. #togetherwegrow

PERCHè TI PIACERà LAVORARE CON NOI Riconosciamo l’importanza di soluzioni di lavoro flessibili per offrirti supporto. Che si tratti di lavoro da remoto, orari flessibili o entrambi, troverai un ambiente che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita privata e vita lavorativa; Al centro della nostra missione c'è la tua carriera, attraverso percorsi di crescita professionale pensati per supportarti nell'esplorare un mondo di opportunità; Ci impegniamo a promuovere la responsabilità sociale creando un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, dove talenti diversi sono valorizzati. La diversità è un pilastro della nostra cultura aziendale, arricchendo il nostro lavoro attraverso esperienze, culture, etnie, stili di comunicazione e comportamenti; Avrai l’opportunità di sviluppare software embedded per sistemi ad alta complessità tecnologica, lavorando su tecnologie come C/C++, CUDA, Model-Based Design e Qt in contesti innovativi e sfidanti. Il valore minimo della fascia corrisponde al trattamento economico minimo previsto dal CCNL applicabile per il livello e mansione sopra indicati e non rappresenta necessariamente la retribuzione di ingresso. Aiutiamo le organizzazioni a immaginare e costruire un futuro intelligente e sostenibile, combinando AI, tecnologia e ingegno umano per trasformare il modo in cui operano, innovano e crescono. Grazie a competenze end-to-end che spaziano dalla strategia alla tecnologia, dall'ingegneria alle operations intelligenti, combiniamo una profonda conoscenza dei settori industriali con competenze all'avanguardia in ambito AI, cloud e dati, trasformando le ambizioni in risultati di business misurabili e scalabili. Supportata da un solido ecosistema di partner e forte di quasi 60 anni di esperienza, Capgemini è un'azienda globale responsabile e diversificata composta da oltre 410.000 persone in più di 50 paesi. Nel 2025 il Gruppo ha registrato ricavi complessivi pari a 22,5 miliardi di euro. Make it real | www.capgemini.com Candidati ora! review_candidates.title: Finance Executive
review_candidates.description: Job Summary The Finance Executive is responsible for supporting the day-to-day financial operations of IMAS International School Kuala Lumpur. The role ensures that financial transactions are accurately recorded, payments and collections are processed on time, financial records are properly maintained, and finance-related matters are handled in accordance with the School’s policies and applicable regulatory requirements. The Finance Executive will work closely with the Finance, HR, Administration, Academic and Management teams to ensure smooth and efficient financial operations across the School. Key Responsibilities 1. Accounts Payable & Payments Process and verify invoices, payment requests, claims and supporting documents. Ensure payments to vendors, suppliers and service providers are processed accurately and within the required timelines. Prepare payment vouchers and payment documentation for approval. Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up with relevant departments where necessary. Maintain proper records of payments and supporting documents. Liaise with vendors and suppliers regarding invoices, payment status and account discrepancies. 2. Accounts Receivable & Collections Monitor student fee collections and outstanding balances. Prepare and issue invoices, receipts and relevant financial documents. Follow up on outstanding payments with parents/guardians and relevant departments. Maintain accurate records of student accounts and payment transactions. Assist with reconciliation of collections received through different payment channels. 3. General Accounting & Reconciliation Perform daily accounting entries and ensure transactions are accurately recorded. Prepare bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies. Assist with monthly closing activities and preparation of financial reports. Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records. Assist in monitoring the School’s cash flow and financial transactions. Support the preparation of schedules, reports and analysis required by management. 4. Payroll & Staff-Related Finance Matters Work closely with HR to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing. Verify payroll-related claims, allowances, deductions and other staff payments. Process staff reimbursements, advances and claims in accordance with School policies. Assist with statutory payment and reporting requirements relating to employees, where applicable. 5. Budget & Financial Reporting Assist in preparing departmental budgets and monitoring actual expenditure against approved budgets. Track expenses and highlight unusual or significant variances to the Finance Manager. Prepare regular financial reports and summaries for management review. Provide financial information and supporting schedules when required by management. 6. Tax & Statutory Compliance Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable Malaysian financial and statutory requirements. Support the preparation and submission of relevant tax, statutory and regulatory documentation. Maintain proper documentation for audit and statutory purposes. Liaise with external auditors, tax agents, banks and relevant authorities when required. 7. Audit & Documentation Prepare supporting documents and schedules for internal and external audits. Ensure financial records are properly filed and easily retrievable. Maintain confidentiality and proper control over financial information. Assist in resolving audit queries and implementing recommendations where required. 8. Internal Controls & Process Improvement Ensure finance transactions are processed in accordance with approved procedures and internal controls. Identify discrepancies, irregularities or weaknesses in financial processes and escalate them appropriately. Recommend improvements to finance processes to increase efficiency and reduce errors. Support the implementation of digitalisation and automation of finance processes where appropriate. 9. Other Responsibilities Provide financial support and advice to other departments when required. Work closely with HR, Administration, Procurement and Management on finance-related matters. Assist with financial projects, school events and other ad hoc assignments as assigned by the Finance Manager or Management. Maintain professionalism, confidentiality and integrity when handling sensitive financial information. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Accuracy and timeliness of financial transactions and records. Timely processing of invoices, payments, claims and collections. Accuracy of bank and account reconciliations. Timely completion of month-end closing activities. Reduction of outstanding receivables and unresolved discrepancies. Compliance with School financial policies and statutory requirements. Accuracy and completeness of audit documentation. Effectiveness in identifying and resolving financial discrepancies. Efficiency and continuous improvement of finance processes. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field. Professional accounting qualification or partial qualification (e.g. ACCA, CPA, CIMA or equivalent) will be an advantage. Minimum 2–4 years of relevant experience in accounting or finance. Experience in a school, education institution, service organisation or similar environment will be an advantage. Good knowledge of accounting principles and Malaysian statutory requirements. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and accounting software. Strong numerical and analytical skills. Good attention to detail and accuracy. Good organisational and time-management skills. Able to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. High level of integrity and confidentiality.

review_candidates.title: Field Service Manager - Scanjet in Gothenburg or Sjöbo
review_candidates.description: About Scanjet Scanjet Marine & System AB , a part of the Alfa Laval Group, is a world-leading and innovative company working with equipment for cleaning and level sensing for marine and land-based oil and chemical tanks. Scanjet was started in 1987 in Sweden where the headquarter remains today. Scanjet has sister companies with sites in Bulgaria, the Netherlands, Poland, Norway, the UK, Shanghai and Indonesia. With these strategic geographical locations and a strong customer focus, we have successfully established ourselves as a world leader in our sector. We have a major focus on future products designed to meet strict industry standards as well as environmental requirements. In our everyday work we are guided by our core values; customer-focused, professional and committed, cost-efficient, and keeping our promises. We are a workplace for everyone, and our success is built on a culture of diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from various backgrounds and experiences. Scanjet is now looking for Field Service Manager to join our After sales organisation. About The Role This role is responsible for leading Scanjet’s Service organisation consisting of 20 employees, Field Service Engineers and Service Coordinators, across Europe and Asia. In this role you will report to the CEO, work closely with other managers within Aftersales and other parts of Scanjet as well as interact with Alfa Laval service & AS organisations. The position is full-time and will be based in either Gothenburg or Sjöbo in Sweden. In this role you can expect to travel approximately 60 days per year. Key Responsibilities Lead Scanjet’s global Service organisation, with overall responsibility for people, performance, budget, and sustainable business growth. Drive Scanjets cooperation with Alfa Laval’s Marine A/S organization in Business Unit MAS and Framo and make sure that best practice is used. Develop and maintain a professional, customer-focused service network for Tank Management. Foster a strong customer-centric culture across the Service organisation. Drive the continuous development of global service operations, ensuring efficiency, safety, regulatory compliance, and high service quality. Lead the implementation of tools, processes, and ways of working that improve operational effectiveness and customer value. Lead, coach, and support team members throughout the employee lifecycle, creating an engaging and inclusive work environment. Oversee service partner agreements, competence development, and service documentation to ensure quality and consistency. Qualifications To succeed in this role, we believe you have the following required qualifications: Relevant education or equivalent work experience. Proven experience leading a service organisation or a company where service is a core business offering. Strong business acumen and commercial mindset. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across different countries, cultures, and regulatory environments. Solution-oriented, positive, and collaborative, prestige-free attitude. Proactive, and results-driven with a hands-on approach. Flexible mindset and ability to adapt and thrive in an international environment. Professional proficiency in both English and Swedish, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment. Not a Requirement But Nice To Have Experience in a leadership or manager role, with demonstrated responsibility for driving business performance and organizational development Hands-on experience managing field service operations within a mechanical and/or electrical engineering environment. What We Offer At Scanjet, you will join a friendly and dynamic workplace with an entrepreneurial spirit. You will have the chance to collaborate and grow together with committed colleagues and to contribute toward the future development and success of Scanjet. We have a strong track record of internal career development and there are endless opportunities within Scanjet in the position as global leader in an exciting fast-moving business. Your application Submit your application including a CV and personal cover letter, in English, no later than 18th of October 2026. All information is handled confidentially in accordance with our GDPR Policy. For More Information, You Are Welcome To Contact Niklas Falkmer, CEO, e-mail: niklas.falkmer@scanjet.net tel. 073‑055 01 09 Anna Lindberg, HR Business Partner e-mail: anna.lindberg@scanjet.net tel. 073-347 09 07 Regina García Moguel, Talent Acquisition Partner, regina.garciamoguel@alfalaval.com The recruitment process is run according to Alfa Laval policies. Employment is directly with Scanjet. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role.

review_candidates.title: Field Deployment Engineer Lead
review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As Field Deployment Lead, you are the senior technical authority on-site for the deployment of our advanced technology systems. You own end-to-end system functionality across hardware and software, lead a team of deployment engineers, and serve as the primary expert operator and trainer — driving customer teams to full operational autonomy. This role combines deep technical ownership with field leadership and a direct customer-facing responsibility in high-stakes environments. Responsibilities Deployment Leadership: Lead on-site deployment of technical systems — including core hardware units, ground infrastructure, and control software — from site survey through customer acceptance. Technical Authority: Own end-to-end system functionality in the field across hardware and software layers; serve as the senior escalation point for technical issues. Team Management: Guide and coordinate a team of Field Deployment Engineers; ensure execution quality, task allocation, and team development on-site. Commissioning & Acceptance: Oversee system configuration, testing, and validation; own the acceptance process through to customer sign-off. Operator Training: Deliver expert-level training to customer teams on system operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting — driving autonomy and operational readiness. Troubleshooting & Escalation: Diagnose and resolve complex hardware, software, and integration issues in the field; escalate unresolved blockers with structured documentation. Cross-functional Coordination: Act as the primary field interface with engineering, programme, and product teams; relay field findings to support iteration and improvement. Documentation: Produce rigorous deployment, acceptance, and training documentation; maintain structured records of site configurations, issues, and resolutions. Candidate Requirements 5+ years of experience in field deployment, systems integration, or technical commissioning on enterprise-grade or complex electronics systems. Demonstrated experience leading a team of engineers in field or operational environments. Hands-on experience with hardware/software integration in operational environments — experience with complex integrated sensing or control systems is a strong plus. Strong systems-level understanding: ability to troubleshoot and own resolution across hardware, software, and connectivity layers. Proven ability to train and bring customer teams — including technical end-users — to operational autonomy on complex systems. High degree of field autonomy and composure in high-stakes, time-sensitive environments. Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organisational skills. Comfortable with a dynamic schedule requiring frequent international presence. Fluency in English required; French and Arabic is a plus. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
